label: NASA LSDA LSDS-8 (comprehensive metabolic panel)
notes: Comprehensive metabolic panel, 4 crew members, 7 timepoints pre/post flight. Consistent with the Inspiration4 mission (4 civilian astronauts, SpaceX, metabolic and immune panels in OSDR), but the LSDS-8 / LSDS-64 identifiers were not confirmed because OSDR pages cannot be read automatically. NASA says there are no restrictions on the use of OSDR data (AWS Open Data registry) and NASA data repositories label each dataset's license; the repository asks to acknowledge the source. Confirm on the dataset page.

title: Recommended Amount of Sleep for a Healthy Adult: A Joint Consensus Statement of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine and Sleep Research Society
notes: Adults 18-60 years: 7 or more hours per night on a regular basis. Terrestrial consensus, not astronaut evidence. Opened and read on 2026-11-14 (by Claude, via web). A teammate should re-confirm before the final release.

title: Seven or more hours of sleep per night: A health necessity for adults
notes: States that sleeping six or fewer hours per night is inadequate to sustain health and safety in adults (quote of the panel moderator). Press release, not the paper. Opened and read on 2026-11-14 (by Claude, via web). A teammate should re-confirm before the final release.

title: Heart rate: What's normal?
notes: Normal resting heart rate for adults 60-100 bpm. Talk to a professional if regularly above 100, or often below 60 when not a trained athlete. General clinical reference. Opened and read on 2026-11-14 (by Claude, via web). A teammate should re-confirm before the final release.
